intent: Build a secure offline-first field asset and incident operations system for unreliable connectivity.
constraints: PostgreSQL is authoritative for server domain state.
Offline clients may queue intent but may not become domain authority.

primary_journeys.description: A seeded authorized user authenticates and reaches the operational dashboard.
An authorized field user opens the asset registry.
An authorized field user opens a registered asset detail page.
A field user captures incident intent offline and later synchronizes exactly one authoritative effect.

acceptance: No primary journey returns an unhandled server error.
Authorization is re-evaluated by server authority.
